scope: Bounded C3GN map: alternative complement pathway dysregulation, acquired convertase stabilization, complement-regulatory variants and glomerular complement deposition. Dense deposit disease is excluded as a phenotype; mixed C3 glomerulopathy studies are labelled and cannot establish C3GN-specific effects. Infection-related and immune-complex glomerulonephritis are excluded.

paragraphs.text: C3 glomerulonephritis is represented here as a heterogeneous complement-associated renal phenotype. In a 12-case C3GN series, acquired C3 nephritic factors and complement-regulatory genetic abnormalities accompanied glomerular accumulation of alternative-pathway and terminal-complement proteins, with hematuria and proteinuria. Patient-derived biochemical assays provide a possible mechanism for one branch: nephritic-factor IgG can stabilize the alternative-pathway C3 convertase and resist its regulation. Historical isolated-C3 glomerulonephritis cohorts also identified complement-regulatory variants, but genetic association and protein deposition do not establish a single sufficient causal pathway in every patient.

Important heterogeneity remains visible. Properdin dependence altered nephritic-factor effects on terminal-pathway activity. Anti-factor H antibodies affected cofactor activity in only selected glomerulopathy samples and did not impair the reported cell-surface protection or ligand-binding assays; these broader-cohort results cannot be assumed for all C3GN. Most native-kidney patients in the small C3GN series had stable function during reported follow-up, so progression is not inevitable over that interval. In APPEAR-C3G, iptacopan reduced proteinuria relative to placebo by 35.1% at six months on background care, supporting a treatment-responsive complement contribution in the enrolled mixed-C3G population; this abstract does not establish a C3GN-specific effect or long-term kidney-survival benefit. This synthesis covers five selected primary abstracts, with incomplete literature screening, no curated regulatory-status catalog and pending independent scientific review.
